Sir Matt Busby managed Manchester United from 1945 to 1969, and again briefly in 1970-71. His tenure is marked by his innovative approach to youth development, particularly the creation of the Busby Babes, a team of young players who won multiple league titles and achieved European Cup glory in 1968. Under his leadership, Manchester United became one of the most successful clubs in football history, winning 13 trophies including five league championships and the European Cup.
